draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
rationale: T1 reports Brisling median latency 41 ms (Corvex A2, fp16) vs Talmar 118 ms (Corvex A1, fp32). The claim uses "may" and reports the numbers exactly. It is scoped to the Brindle-Voice test set. Caveat: latencies measured on different accelerators, but the claim's hedged wording and exact numbers are supported.
